title: Developing Safe and Responsible Large Language Model : Can We Balance Bias Reduction and Language Understanding ?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating toxicity percentages using ToxiGen-RoBERTa on the Toxigen test set, measuring stereotypical bias using the StereoSet benchmark with metrics like Stereotype Score (SS) and Idealized Context Association Test (ICAT), and assessing the removal of gender-coded language in a job posting case study.

Evaluating toxicity percentages for various racial and ethnic groups (e.g., Black, Asian, Native American) using ToxiGen-RoBERTa on the Toxigen test set, and measuring stereotypical bias using the StereoSet benchmark.
Evaluating toxicity percentages for religious groups (e.g., Muslim, Jewish) using ToxiGen-RoBERTa on the Toxigen test set, and measuring stereotypical bias using the StereoSet benchmark.
Measuring stereotypical bias associated with professions using the Intrasentence test of the StereoSet benchmark via Stereotype Score (SS) and Language Modeling Score (LMS).
Evaluating toxicity percentages for the LGBTQ demographic using ToxiGen-RoBERTa on the Toxigen test set.
Evaluating toxicity percentages for mental and physical disability groups using ToxiGen-RoBERTa on the Toxigen test set.
Evaluating toxicity percentages for specific nationalities (e.g., Chinese, Mexican, Latino) using ToxiGen-RoBERTa on the Toxigen test set.
Evaluated qualitatively through the custom Content Moderation Dataset (CMD) annotations and assessed for bias mitigation in a real-world case study focused on debiasing job postings.
